title: docker: Add support for listing referrers
body:
This PR adds `docker.ListReferrers` to list artifacts attached to a subject image (identified by its digest), such as signatures and SBOMS, using the OCI Distribution Spec v1.1 as described in: https://github.com/opencontainers/distribution-spec/blob/v1.1.0/spec.md#listing-referrers

`ListReferrers` returns OCI descriptors for those artifacts. to a given subject (the parent image). It queries `/v2/<name>/referrers/<digest>`, and if it's not available in the registry, `ListReferrers` falls back to [using the referrers tag schema](https://github.com/opencontainers/distribution-spec/blob/v1.1.0/spec.md#unavailable-referrers-api) as defined in the spec.

The client follows pagination links using a helper (`nextPagePath`), which encapsulates the logic that was already being used by `SearchRegistry` and `GetRepositoryTags`.
